reviews.review: definitely a robot with a quest

I ♥♥♥♥♥♥ love Roboquest dood. The guns feel fantastic, secret rooms are nice to run through even after hundreds of runs, speed is incentivized, and character abilities do very well to distinguish them from each other. If you want to have a chill run, difficulty is customizable; but if you want to put your skills on display you can crank up the enemies capabilities even more from the main hub.

Gun types are plentiful, all having a mastery bar which rewards a card upon filling it (if collecting all the cards is your kinda thing, I'm a fan personally). There is 3 different types of elemental damage (and explosions kind of but I don't think that really counts) to capitalize on and build around with Ice being my personal favorite. 

Runs are somewhat shorter than in other games of this genre but I'd argue that leaves them still fulfilling in victory and not too punishing in defeat. There are lots of secrets, alternate routes, and NPCs to interact with that will all add something meaningful to either the hub before each run or in the little rest rooms present in the middle and end of every area. 


There are *very* light roguelite elements present, with a skill tree of some sort that you can progress with a currency earned during each run, but I didn't find it all too impactful and filled it out relatively quickly. The more significant unlockables in this game are the characters, which all catered to different skill levels and playstyles.


Roboquest is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ phenomenal with a friend. Their presence will certainly be appreciated too because some of the little challenge rooms you get locked in can definitely test your skills quite a bit, another set of hands should make things that much more manageable. Me and my friend's favorite combo was me playing the mage character and running a close-quarters build with dual shotguns while he played an engineer and distracted enemies with his multiple drones or a buddy-bot.

The enemies are satisfying to shoot, and the game really rewards good aim. The movement is fast, fluid, and butter-smooth. There are lots of classes to learn and plenty of guns to try.

For a PvE shooter, this game checks all the boxes for me.
